description: This file defines a SpeechPipeline actor for handling real-time speech recognition using AVFoundation and Speech frameworks. It includes structures and enums for speech segments and errors, manages microphone input, and processes voice data through transcriber and analyzer modules.

classes.name: SpeechPipeline
classes.description: An actor that manages real-time speech recognition pipeline, including microphone input, transcription, and analysis.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins the speech recognition process, manages authorization, sets up audio input, and returns an asynchronous stream of speech segments.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Terminates the speech recognition pipeline and releases resources.

methods.name: handleBuffer
methods.description: Converts an audio buffer to the target format and feeds it into the analysis pipeline.

methods.name: requestAuthorizationIfNeeded
methods.description: Checks and requests speech recognition authorization if not determined.
